ai.lead: FreeRemoveBg uses IS-Net, a segmentation model presented by researchers at the ECCV 2022 conference and designed for highly accurate cutouts. Your browser downloads it once from Hugging Face (179 MB), then runs it itself: on your graphics card with WebGPU, or on your processor with WebAssembly.

free.a: Yes. No credits, no subscription, no watermark, no limit on the number or the size of downloads. Your own device does the computing, so each picture costs nothing to run, and the code is open source under the MIT license.

model.a: IS-Net, a segmentation model presented by Xuebin Qin and his co-authors at the ECCV 2022 conference ("Highly Accurate Dichotomous Image Segmentation"). Its ONNX version, under the Apache-2.0 license, is run in your browser by ONNX Runtime Web and Transformers.js.

download.q: Why does a model have to be downloaded?
download.a: Because the AI runs on your device, not on a server. Before the first cutout, FreeRemoveBg asks you before downloading the model (179 MB) from Hugging Face. Your browser then keeps it: next time nothing is downloaded again, and everything works even offline.

alternative.q: Is it an alternative to remove.bg?
alternative.a: Yes. FreeRemoveBg does the same job, removing the background of a picture automatically, with a background editor, a brush and batch processing. The differences: it is free at full size, it needs no account, and pictures are processed in your browser instead of being uploaded. FreeRemoveBg is an independent project, not affiliated with remove.bg.

quality.q: How good is the cutout, and at what size?
quality.a: IS-Net handles hair, fur and fine details well on people, animals, products and objects. The picture is analysed at 1024 pixels, then the result is saved at the size of your photo, up to about 6,000 × 4,000 pixels (4,900 × 3,300 on iPhone and iPad). Cropping around a small subject before the cutout helps the AI; an object it missed can be rescued by drawing around it.

privacy.q: Are my pictures uploaded to a server?
privacy.a: No. Pictures are opened, processed and saved by your browser, on your device. The site only delivers the application files, and the AI model is downloaded once from Hugging Face. You can check it in your browser's developer tools: no request carries a picture.

formats.a: In: every picture your browser can open, which means JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF and BMP everywhere, and HEIC on iPhone and Mac with Safari. Out: PNG or WebP with transparency, JPG with a background, or a copy to the clipboard.

batch.q: Can I process several pictures at once?
batch.a: Yes. Add as many pictures as you want, prepare each one if you like, then cut them all out in one click. The chosen background applies to all of them, and one button downloads everything as a ZIP archive.

commercial.q: Can I use the results commercially?
commercial.a: Yes. You keep every right on your pictures, and the model used (IS-Net, under the Apache-2.0 license) allows commercial use. You only need the rights on the original pictures.

offline.a: Yes, after the first use. Once the application and the AI model are in your browser, everything runs without a connection. You can also install FreeRemoveBg as an app from your browser.

iphone.a: Yes, on recent iPhones and iPads, but more slowly than on a computer: the AI uses the processor there and needs a lot of memory (close to 1 GB) during a cutout. On older models Safari may close the tab for lack of memory; a computer remains the most comfortable.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: FreeRemoveBg is designed so that your pictures never leave your device. This page explains plainly what is processed, and where.

sections.title: In short
body: No upload: your pictures and their results are processed in your browser and are never sent to the publisher or to anyone else.
No account, no cookies, no analytics, no advertising.

sections.title: What stays on your device
body: The pictures you open are read by your browser. Finding the subject (the AI model), changing the background, retouching and saving are all computed locally, on your graphics card or your processor.
Pictures and results are kept in the page's memory only: they are not stored, and they are gone as soon as you close or reload the tab. Download what you want to keep.

sections.title: Local storage
body: The application saves your interface preferences (language, theme) in your browser's local storage, and keeps its own files and the downloaded AI model in the browser cache so it can work offline. These items are strictly necessary for the service, are never used to track you and therefore need no consent banner.
You can erase them at any time by deleting this site's data in your browser's settings.

sections.title: Server
body: The server only delivers the application files and keeps no access logs. Like any web server, it technically receives your IP address to answer requests, but does not store it.

sections.title: Third parties
body: Cloudflare: every request to this site goes through Cloudflare, which protects the server and encrypts the connection. Like any network intermediary, it processes your IP address and your browser's standard information to route the pages, and may keep technical logs for security purposes; it never receives your pictures, which never leave your device. See its [privacy policy](https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/).

Hugging Face: the AI model is downloaded straight from huggingface.co once you agree to it, before your first cutout, then kept by your browser. Hugging Face then receives your IP address and your browser's usual information, but never your pictures. See its [privacy policy](https://huggingface.co/privacy).
GitHub: only if you follow a link to the source code repository.
No other third party is contacted: a strict Content-Security-Policy technically prevents the page from connecting anywhere else.

As the publisher holds no data about you, there is usually nothing to consult, but you can send any question to maxence.bonnici@outlook.com. You can also lodge a complaint with the French data protection authority, the CNIL ([cnil.fr](https://www.cnil.fr)).

accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.intro: FreeRemoveBg aims to be usable by everyone, whatever the device or the way of browsing. This statement describes where the site stands against the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, level AA.

sections.title: Conformance status
body: The site is partially conformant with WCAG 2.2 level AA: most criteria are met, and the exceptions are listed below. This assessment was made by the publisher (keyboard, screen reader and contrast checks); it is not a third-party audit.

sections.title: What is in place
body: Every function of the public pages and the main path of the tool (agreeing to the model, choosing pictures, turning, mirroring and cropping them, removing the background, choosing a background, downloading) work with the keyboard alone, with a visible focus and a link to skip to the content.
Pages are structured with headings and landmarks, buttons and fields have names, and the progress and the result of the processing are announced to screen readers.
Text and controls meet AA contrast in both the light and the dark theme, the layout adapts down to 320 px wide and to 200 % zoom, and animations are disabled when your system asks for reduced motion.
The site is available in English and in French, and each page declares its language.

sections.title: Content that is not accessible
body: The erase and restore brush and the rescue of an area need a pointer (mouse, finger or stylus): they have no keyboard equivalent. The automatic cutout, preparing the picture, the backgrounds and the downloads do not depend on them.
The preview of a picture is a drawing surface described by a short text only (the name of the file and its state): the content of your own pictures cannot be described automatically.
The changelog is written in English only, including on the French version of the site.
Dropping files and pasting from the clipboard are shortcuts; the "Choose images" button always offers the same function.

sections.title: Feedback and contact
body: If something blocks you, write to maxence.bonnici@outlook.com or open an issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/ImMaxence/FreeRemoveBg/issues): describe the page, what you were trying to do and the tool you use. An answer and, when possible, a fix will follow.
